items.prompt: With N=3, which exercise opportunities does this finite tree actually model?

options.text: Only maturity, with no earlier exercise.
options.why: That removes the American-enabled max at earlier nodes.

options.text: Every continuously available instant with no approximation.
options.why: A finite grid does not test all continuous times.
There are N+1 tree dates; continuous-time exercise is a separate limit/model question.

options.text: A new exercise date after maturity.
options.why: No post-maturity exercise date belongs to this valuation grid.
